canDo: Can develop an opinion with structures of purpose, concession and emphasis, and tell apart the common contexts that trigger the subjonctif / indicatif.
review: Review D25; add pour que/afin que, bien que, ce qui/ce que/ce dont…c’est.
input: Listening and reading on technology/social media.
output: Write a 150-word opinion; speak for 3–4 minutes, answering the other side.
checkpoint: A complete chain opinion → reason → example → concession → response → conclusion; justified choices of subjonctif/indicatif.
challenge: Today’s challenge: count how many times notifications on your phone interrupt you today, then write a 5-sentence comment: state a purpose with pour que + subjonctif, add a concession with bien que or même si, highlight a point with Ce qui me dérange, c’est…, and end with a rule to improve your own habits.
